explanation: Locate the predecessor of the 1-based sublist start using a dummy head. Repeatedly remove the node after the sublist’s original first node and insert it at the sublist front, reversing the selected range only.
timeComplexity: O(n) time in the worst case.
spaceComplexity: O(1) auxiliary space and one dummy node.
